title: Add multi-selection and copy options to the debugger Errors panel
body:
## Multi-selection and copy options for the debugger Errors panel

Previously the **Debugger → Errors** panel only allowed selecting and copying a single error at a time. This makes it easier to grab debugger output for bug reports and logs.

### Changes
- **Multi-selection** — the errors tree switches from `SELECT_ROW` to `SELECT_MULTI`, so errors/warnings can be selected with `Shift`-click (range) and `Ctrl`-click (toggle). Click-to-navigate is preserved by listening to `cell_selected` (emitted in `SELECT_MULTI`) instead of `item_selected`.
- **"Copy All" toolbar button** — copies every error/warning, enabled/disabled in lockstep with the existing Expand/Collapse/Clear buttons.
- **Right-click "Copy Message Only"** — copies just the summary line(s), alongside the existing **"Copy Error"** which keeps the full detail (C++ source + stack trace). *Open C++ Source on GitHub* is shown only when a single error is selected.
- **`Ctrl+C`** copies the current selection (detailed).

Copying handles multiple selected errors, de-duplicates by parent error, and preserves panel order. The original single-item copy formatting is refactored into shared `_format_error()` / `_copy_errors()` helpers, so single-error copies are byte-for-byte unchanged.

### Notes
- `SELECT_MULTI` highlights the selected cell rather than the whole row (Godot's `Tree` has no multi-row mode); copy maps any selected cell back to its parent error, so this is purely cosmetic.

### Related
- Proposal: godotengine/godot-proposals#15049
- godotengine/godot-proposals#12657 (Stack Trace panel)
- godotengine/godot-proposals#5233 (copy message without extra detail)

### Testing
Built locally (`scons platform=windows target=editor`). Ran a project that emits errors/warnings, then verified: Shift/Ctrl multi-select, Ctrl+C, right-click Copy Error / Copy Message Only on a multi-selection, and the Copy All button.
